text:
Maria R: heads up — p99 latency spike on shared-gpu pool 'A' starting ~03:12 UTC, coincides with a big burst from tenant alpha-search :thinking_face:
AJ: saw that on dashboards, p50 ok but p99 doubled, throughput dropped ~30% for a 10m window
Devin: posting initial flamegraph and KV-cache stats
Devin: ```
flamegraph: serving_loop -> kernel_dispatch -> cuda_kernel_q -> nvtx_region  (heavy)
KV cache lookups: hit 62% -> dropped to 38% during spike
avg batch size: 1.9 -> 6.8 during burst
GPU occupancy: 48% -> 92% (single tenant large sequences)
```
Sasha: that KV cache hit drop suggests prefix churn — alpha-search might be doing many unique prefixes or long contexts
Chris: I pulled tenant telemetry: alpha-search had 18 concurrent streams, median seq_len 1024, a handful of sessions with 8k tokens each (streaming).
Maria R: any kernel selection changes around that time? recent runtime rollout yesterday changed heuristic for short-vs-long kernel threshold to 512 tokens
AJ: yes, rollout to pool A at 02:40 UTC. It switches to 'long-seq' kernels when expected_seq >= 512 which changes memory layout and reduces coalesced batching ability
Devin: combining long-kernel + high concurrency + KV miss churn explains tail — kernels take longer, batching can't fuse small requests because single tenant is occupying many slots
Sasha: noisy neighbor pattern: alpha-search holding KV cache slots and causing eviction noise for other tenants, then they fallback to recompute -> amplification
Maria R: infra-bot, can you show recent scheduling and preemption logs for pool A?
infra-bot: scheduling snapshot for pool A at 03:12:
- active_jobs: 72
- per-tenant top: alpha-search 18, beta-chat 9, misc other 45
- preemptions: 3 (models evicted for hot swap)
- cuda_smem_pressure: high
AJ: recommend immediate mitigation: limit per-tenant concurrent streams to 8 on pool A and throttle alpha-search to smaller max_seq for now
Chris: rolling a soft cap now (canary) on pool A config: 
```json
{"per_tenant_max_streams": 8, "max_sequence_length_override": 2048}
```
Maria R: also rollback the kernel threshold heuristic to previous 256 for pool A entirely until we confirm behavior
Devin: running a repro: load generator that mimics alpha-search long sessions, testing old vs new kernel selector + KV cache pinning patch
Sasha: we should instrument per-tenant KV-cache occupancy and eviction_rate, add alert if single tenant > 30% cache slots
AJ: agree — open a ticket to add that metric and an automated short-term throttle rule
Chris: can confirm canary applied at 03:28 UTC, alpha-search stream count dropped from 18->8, p99 trending back down within 4 minutes :thumbsup:
Maria R: timeline for root cause investigation:
- immediate: soft cap + rollback kernel threshold (done)
- short term: add per-tenant KV occupancy metric + throttle rule (owned AJ)
- mid term: revisit kernel selector to consider per-tenant affinity & batching fragmentation (owned Devin)
- long term: consider tenant-reservations or weighted fairness in scheduler to prevent single-tenant burst amplification (owned Sasha)
Devin: preliminary repro notes: when batch fusion fails due to kernel mode mismatch, overhead ~18-22ms per request added; with high concurrency that cascades
AJ: we should also add a unit harness for 'kernel mode churn' that runs in CI to detect perf regressions when selector logic changes
Maria R: excellent. Chris, please keep monitoring pool A for 1 hour and postpings. AJ, make ticket for KV metric and CI harness. Devin/Sasha pair on root cause doc and perfbench.
Chris: monitoring — will post p99/p50 graphs in 10m and update thread
infra-bot: action_log: rollback_kernel_selector -> executed at 03:30 UTC by AJ; soft_cap_config -> applied at 03:28 UTC by Chris
Maria R: thanks team — closing the immediate incident but keep this thread for notes and root cause writeup. :sparkles:
AJ: leaving some quick commands I used for debugging:
AJ: ```
kubectl logs -n inference runtime-pool-a --since=20m | jq '.metrics | {p50,p99,throughput}'
python tools/kv_cache_inspect.py --pool A --top 20
```
Devin: attaching repro command: `./bench/gen_load.py --tenant alpha-search --streams 20 --seqdist heavy_long --duration 600`
Sasha: notes for root cause doc: kernel_selector should consider "batch fusion penalty" when toggling modes; KV cache pinning for hot prefixes might prevent eviction storms
Maria R: action items summary (quick):
- AJ: create KV occupancy alert + CI kernel-churn test (ETA 48h)
- Devin: reproduce and write perf microbenchmark with old/new selector (ETA 24h)
- Sasha: scheduler design proposal for weighted fairness (ETA 1w)
- Chris: monitor and confirm stability (ETA ongoing)
Maria R: thanks — end of thread.
